message.content: On September 16th, WolfgangSchulz suggested incorporating improvisational solos into their practice sessions. He shared his enthusiasm for this idea, believing it could significantly enhance their jazz fusion skills and make the practice sessions more fun and creative. LiHua agreed wholeheartedly, stating that improvisation would challenge them and help them grow as musicians. Yuriko Yamamoto was also excited about the prospect of expressing themselves musically through improvisation. WolfgangSchulz proposed a "flow" approach, suggesting they should "vibe off each other and see where it takes us," emphasizing the importance of having fun and spontaneity in the practice sessions. He expressed readiness to start this new approach during their regular Sunday night practices.
